test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III, You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts Decide which of the given concussions logically follow(s) from the given statement. 

**Statements :**

All hats are caps

All caps are gloves

Some hats are goggles

**Conclusions:**

(i) Some goggles are caps

(ii) Some gloves are goggles

(iii) No goggle is a glove

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follows
Only conclusions II and III follow
